complexity.interpretation: Simulation-design proxies only; none is K_true.
complexity.previous_748_803_explanation: The earlier 748-803 range was inherited from the production loss parent-channel range so M1-M4 isotope channels above the 798 isolation edge were retained. It is not the acquisition isolation window and is removed from precursor-evidence complexity analysis.
complexity.precursor_group_definition: Candidates are grouped when their M0 precursors map, under the exact historical nearest-source-channel rule (<0.025 Da), to the same frozen source channel; observed support is read from the frozen empirical-overlap peak-response matrix and restricted to final channels inside 748-798 m/z.

preregistered_K_stress_grid_proposal.role: Experimental stress axis only; not a recommended or estimated biological K.
preregistered_K_stress_grid_proposal.design: Spans sparse to full-library stress, with denser coverage around both the foreground observed-group P10-P90 region and the compatible-candidate-sum P10-P90 region.

abundance.selection_rule: Choose between the two preregistered models using fidelity to observed abundance quantiles/rank curve only; solver accuracy was not evaluated.
abundance.selection_result: empirical rank-resampling retained because it preserves the observed rank curve directly; the single log-normal has nonzero log-quantile error.
abundance.source: frozen production X on 15,837 foreground pixels
abundance.normalization_for_shape_only: Within each pixel, active abundances are divided by their active sum. Total signal scale is modeled separately from real B.

empirical_rank_resampling.future_sampling_rule: Sample one stored empirical descending normalized rank profile; truncate/interpolate only after the approved K is fixed, then renormalize weights to unit shape before applying B-norm scale.

preregistered_tail_scenarios.lighter_tail: Raise each sampled empirical rank weight to power 0.75, then renormalize to unit sum.
preregistered_tail_scenarios.central: Unmodified empirical rank-resampling profile, then renormalize to unit sum.
preregistered_tail_scenarios.heavier_tail: Raise each sampled empirical rank weight to power 1.25, then renormalize to unit sum.
preregistered_tail_scenarios.equal_abundance_control: All K active members receive weight 1/K; control only.

abundance.prohibition: Model choice and parameters must not be changed after viewing future solver accuracy.

signal_scale.source: frozen normalized production B, foreground pixels only
signal_scale.future_scaling_rule: For a generated abundance shape x, compute ||A x||_2 and multiply x by the linear factor required to hit a preregistered real-B norm quantile.
signal_scale.normalization_warning: Do not force sum(X_true)=1 as a final abundance scale; unit-sum is used only temporarily for abundance shape.

stop_rule: Envelope audit complete. Stop before X_true generation and production ISTA execution; wait for human approval.
